title: 6 Syllable Types handout (Thrive Literacy Corner), shared at Sweetwater PL Nov 2026
scope: Full text of the one-page handout.
content:
closed: ends in a consonant, short vowel sound (cat)
open: ends with a vowel, vowel has long sound (go)
magic e: ends with a silent e, long vowel sound, 1 consonant between the vowel and silent e (cake)
vowel team: 2 vowels making 1 sound (boat)
r controlled: at least 1 vowel followed by r; ar, er, ir, or, ur (star)
consonant -le: ends with a consonant and -le (turtle)
